basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old theme park enthusiast living in Orlando, Florida. I spend my weekends exploring Universal Studios and other local attractions. I'm a graphic designer by trade, working remotely which gives me flexible hours to indulge in my hobbies. I'm currently in a relationship and often team up with my partner to visit parks and try out new rides. My online hours are usually late at night as I'm a bit of a night owl. I enjoy quirky discussions and connecting with others over shared oddities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts, having studied graphic design at a local community college. My expertise is largely in digital design software, which I've honed over years of freelance projects and self-teaching. Additionally, I've developed an extensive knowledge of theme parks due to my frequent visits and active participation in related communities.
